title: Beds
lead: Canopies, upholstered beds, solid wood and low platforms. Most come with a choice of headboards, finishes and footboards.
intro: Every bed here has a number. Ask about a bed by its number and we will come back with sizes, finishes, pricing and lead time.

models.name: Reeded Bed
models.summary: Vertical wood reeding wraps the base, under a tall upholstered or reeded headboard.
details: Reeded wood base with rounded corners
Headboard in cream upholstery or matching reeding
Also made as a four-poster canopy
models.more: The headboard comes upholstered in cream or reeded to match, standard or wall-width, with or without a footboard. There's a four-poster canopy version too.

models.name: Upholstered Plinth Bed
models.summary: A tall upholstered headboard over a low plinth base.
details: Low plinth in matching upholstery or reeded wood
models.more: The plinth comes upholstered to match or in reeded wood, and the headboard comes standard or extended past the bed.

models.name: Wood-Framed Upholstered Bed
models.summary: Cream upholstery outlined in a slim band of light wood.
details: Tall upholstered headboard edged in wood
Also made as a four-poster canopy
models.more: Choose a straight or wing headboard, with or without a footboard, or the four-poster canopy version.

models.name: Tapered-Leg Panel Bed
models.summary: Upholstered panels on a light wood frame with slim tapered legs.
details: Canopy version, shown with a cognac tufted headboard
models.more: The headboard comes plain or button-tufted, with or without a footboard. The canopy version is shown with a cognac tufted headboard.

models.name: Framed Headboard Bed
models.summary: A headboard set into a wood surround, on a deep plinth base.
details: Also made as a four-poster canopy
models.more: It comes in natural wood or dark brown, with an upholstered or wood headboard, with or without a footboard, and as a four-poster canopy.

models.name: Inset Panel Bed
models.summary: A wood frame with an inset headboard panel, on slim tapered feet.
details: Also made as a four-poster canopy
models.more: Natural or warm brown wood, an upholstered or wood panel, with or without a footboard. There's a four-poster canopy version too.

models.name: Slim-Leg Wing Bed
models.summary: A wing headboard and upholstered rails on a light wood base with slim legs.
details: Wing headboard in wood or upholstery
Upholstery shown in cognac, cream and channel-tufted taupe
Light wood base on slim legs
Also made as a dark wood canopy
models.more: The headboard comes in wood, cognac, cream or channel-tufted taupe, with or without a footboard. There's a dark wood canopy version too.

models.name: Block-Foot Panel Bed
models.summary: A wood-framed panel bed on short block feet.
models.more: Upholstered or wood headboard, natural or warm brown wood, with or without a footboard, plus four canopy versions.

models.name: Rounded-Corner Wood Bed
models.summary: Wood panels with softened corners, from the headboard down to the base.
details: Also made as a four-poster canopy
models.more: With or without a footboard, or as a four-poster canopy.

models.name: Low Platform Bed
models.summary: A low platform bed with a tall wood or upholstered headboard.
details: Low platform base, one version with a wide ledge
models.more: The headboard comes in wood or cream upholstery, and there are canopy versions in pale wood.

models.name: Tailored Upholstered Bed
models.summary: A white upholstered bed, shown with plain, button-tufted and channeled headboards.
details: Plain, button-tufted, vertical channel or horizontal channel headboard
models.more: Shown with plain, button-tufted and channeled headboards, standard or wall-width, with or without a footboard.

models.name: Sculpted Upholstered Bed
models.summary: Two soft shapes: a squared box frame, and a curved frame whose headboard sweeps around one side.
details: Box frame shown in camel, with or without a footboard
Curved frame shown in cream textured fabric
models.more: There's a squared box frame, shown in camel, and a curved frame in cream textured fabric whose headboard wraps around one side.

models.name: Floating Platform Bed
models.summary: A platform on a recessed base, so the bed seems to hover above the floor.
details: Canopy versions in black and natural wood
models.more: Upholstered or wood headboard, plus canopy versions in black and natural wood.

models.name: Cane-Panel Bed
models.summary: A rounded wood frame holding woven cane or upholstered panels.
details: Also made as a four-poster canopy
models.more: Panels come in woven cane or cream upholstery, the frame in natural or dark wood, with or without a footboard. There's a canopy version too.

models.name: Wide-Panel Platform Bed
models.summary: A low wood platform with a headboard that can run wider than the bed.
models.more: The headboard comes in wood planks or cream upholstery, standard width or extra wide.

models.name: Reeded Marble-Look Bed
models.summary: Reeding from headboard to base, in a dark marble-look finish.
details: Dark brown marble-look finish with light veining
models.more: The reeded headboard and base are finished in a dark brown marble look with light veining.

models.name: Rounded Upholstered Bed
models.summary: A low bed with a soft, rounded headboard, in cream textured fabric.
models.more: Fully upholstered in a cream textured fabric, with a deep, low base.

models.name: Slouch Upholstered Bed
models.summary: A low, wide frame with loose cushions for a headboard.
models.more: Shown in charcoal and in white.

models.name: Arched-Headboard Bed
models.summary: A cream upholstered bed with a headboard shaped like an arch.
models.more: Fully upholstered in a cream textured fabric.

models.name: Soft Block Bed
models.summary: A fully upholstered bed on chunky rounded legs.
models.more: Upholstered all over in a cream textured fabric, legs included.

models.name: Slim Metal-Frame Bed
models.summary: Upholstered panels held in a slim brass-tone frame.
details: Slim brass-tone frame with a textured finish
Also made as a four-poster canopy
models.more: With or without a footboard, or as a four-poster canopy.

models.name: Rounded-Plinth Bed
models.summary: A wood bed on a plinth with softly rounded edges.
details: Upholstered or wood headboard in a wood frame
Also made as a four-poster canopy
models.more: Upholstered or wood headboard, with or without a footboard, or as a four-poster canopy.

models.name: Rustic-Grain Wood Bed
models.summary: Wood with a strong, rustic grain, shaped into a wing headboard.
details: Wing headboard in rustic-grain wood, or upholstered inside a wood frame
models.more: The wing headboard comes in wood or upholstered inside a wood frame, with or without a footboard, plus two canopy versions.

models.name: Offset Canopy Bed
models.line: Canopy with an angled top rail
models.summary: A canopy bed with an angled top rail, and panel beds in the same family.
details: Canopy with an angled top rail
Panel version with a tall wood or upholstered headboard
models.more: Shown in natural, red-brown and dark brown wood. The panel versions have a tall wood or upholstered headboard.

models.name: Channel-Tufted Canopy Bed
models.summary: A wood four-poster with a channel-tufted headboard and upholstered rails.
models.more: The frame comes in dark or light wood, with a cream channel-tufted headboard.

models.name: Solid Platform Bed
models.summary: A thick wood platform and a tall plank headboard.
models.more: There are three canopy versions as well.

models.name: Low Rustic Platform Bed
models.summary: A low platform in rustic wood, with a tall plank headboard.
details: Platform deck on angled wood runners
models.more: The platform deck sits on angled wood runners, so the bed looks lighter than it is.

models.name: Wraparound Bed
models.summary: A curved headboard that wraps around the pillows, on a low base.
details: Fully upholstered, or upholstered inside a wood shell
models.more: Fully upholstered in cream, or with a wood base and shell.

models.name: Sloped-Headboard Platform Bed
models.summary: A wood platform with the headboard set at a lean, like a backrest.
models.more: The headboard leans back at an angle, like a backrest.
